entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to make a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I hope it's not too late.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, it was an impulse buy. I just changed my mind, and I really don't use it like I thought I would. I've been a loyal customer for years and I feel really bad about this, but I could really use the money back.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered 20 days ago, on December 24th.
Yes, that's right. Is that... is that going to be a problem?

Not at all. I'm just checking our policy here... and it states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only at day 20, you are unfortunately outside the window. I can go ahead and start that return for you right now.
Oh, wow. Really? That's such a relief! Thank you so, so much, Charlie. You have no idea how much this helps.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email address. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been wonderful. Thank you again!
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
